title: Vertical Pocket Scan and Tactical Response Plan for Emerging LLM Differentiators
creator: Maya Patel
description: Objective: Rapidly surface high-value product and positioning opportunities by mapping 12 target verticals to emerging model capabilities and vendor go-to-market moves. Deliver a prioritized set of defensive and offensive plays (3 tactical plays per vertical) that Product and Growth can execute in the next 90 days. Scope: focus on model differentiators (privacy modes, cost-per-token economics, specialized instruction tuning, structured output, multimodal capabilities) and vendor tactics (pricing bundles, SLAs, private deployment offers). Methods: analyst synthesis of public signals, 8 customer discovery interviews per vertical, telemetry review for vertical-related usage patterns, and competitive win/loss interviews from sales. Deliverables: 1) Vertical capability matrix PDF, 2) Prioritized tactical playbook (playbook.md), 3) Tracking dashboard wireframe and tags for Redwood Console observability, 4) 90-day near-term roadmap recommendations for PM/Eng. Success metric: PM/GTM adoption of >=2 plays within 60 days and documented uplift in sales conversations or trial conversions for targeted verticals.
acceptance_criteria: Deliver vertical capability matrix with scoring for 12 verticals
Produce 36 tactical plays with owners and success metrics
Prototype tracking dashboard wireframe and tag taxonomy
Stakeholder review completed (Eng, Sales, Solutions, Design) with sign-off
